findings: Official index identifies the linked write-up as first place.
Winner uses two LightGBM regressors, not the intake Beta/UCB algorithm.
Initial threshold has a discrete uniform 0..100 prior; own rewards update a discrete likelihood under shared decay.
Ten features combine own posterior estimates and opponent action history.
One RMSE regressor targets the raw initial threshold; the second targets 1.02 raised to that threshold.
Inference inverses the transformed prediction, blends using a normalized decreasing sigmoid schedule, multiplies by shared selection decay and chooses the maximal score.
Implementation initializes transformed and raw prior means separately; opponent consecutive-choice feature is global, unlike the per-bandit wording in the prose.
